profile.title: Software Engineer — AI / LLM Applications
profile.description: I build backend systems and LLM-powered features that hold up in production. For 4+ years I’ve shipped and run the platforms behind a mortgage fintech, including ~2 years as the only engineer on both of them.
profile.intro: Hi, welcome to my portfolio! I’m Julio, a software engineer who enjoys turning complicated processes into software that simply works. For 4+ years I built and ran the platforms of a mortgage fintech, two of those years as its only engineer, including an AI feature that reads bank statements to estimate how much an applicant can afford.
profile.summary: Software engineer with 4+ years building production systems for a mortgage fintech, including ~2 years as the sole engineer owning two platforms end-to-end. I shipped an LLM-powered payment-capacity assessment to production and built the Node.js/TypeScript APIs and AWS Lambda services behind mortgage and document workflows that handle sensitive financial data.
profile.now: These days I’m focused on AI applications: structured outputs, retrieval, tool calling and evaluation. Take a look around: my experience, the projects I’m building and the tools I work with.

highlights.label: years as sole engineer on two platforms
repos moved to GitHub Actions CI/CD

chiplo.context: Mortgage fintech with two products: Chiplo (mortgage origination for real-estate agents and brokers) and Docupass (document collection and e-signature). Sole engineer for ~2 years after a team downsizing, owning both end-to-end, from features to production support.

bullets.text: Built and shipped an LLM-powered payment-capacity assessment for mortgage applicants (Python, AWS Lambda, GPT-4), with an explainable reasoning summary shown in a Next.js app.

Built a versioned template editor for mortgage application forms (10+ templates, 5 lenders): field remaps are published in minutes instead of up to a full day, with safe rollback to any earlier version.
Built and operated AWS Lambda services that auto-fill, compress, merge and package mortgage documents into secure ZIP downloads via pre-signed S3 URLs; the PDF compressor cuts file size by up to 40%.
Built Chiplo’s real-estate partner network: agency and agent registration, plus per-agency property projects whose data and documents advisors attach to each client’s mortgage file.

Maintained the core TypeScript/Express API (application workflows, e-signatures, credit-bureau checks, webhooks, error notifications) and replaced manual builds and deploys with GitHub Actions CI/CD across 10+ repos.

freelance.context: Designed and built an order management system for a local restaurant: per-table and per-customer orders, order status, and menu and inventory management.
